• Explain key facts about JAGGAER, its solutions and its clients

• Observe how JI solutions meet real world business needs
• Experience how suppliers interact with JAGGAER clients
• Explore ways to find help in the application
• Summarize common administrative concepts and tasks
• Understand configurability of the portfolio of solutions
